````text
  --surface-hover: #fafbfd;
  --ink: #252e3f;
  --muted: #858d9d;
  --secondary: #647083;
  --border: #e7ebf0;
  --accent: #9be5f1;
  --accent-ink: #24535d;
  --accent-soft: #eaf7f9;
  --teal: #36858c;
  --sidebar: #1b2130;
  --shadow: 0 3px 14px #1d293907;
  --danger: #c25b60;
  --font-body: var(--font-inter), sans-serif;
  color-scheme: light;
}
[data-theme="dark"] {
  --background: #141a25;
  --surface: #1d2533;
  --surface-hover: #242e3e;
  --ink: #e7ecf3;
  --muted: #929daf;
  --secondary: #acb7c7;
  --border: #2b3545;
  --accent: #8bdbe7;
  --accent-ink: #16414a;
  --accent-soft: #213a42;
  --teal: #8dd8dc;
  --sidebar: #101620;
  --danger: #ec9296;
  --shadow: 0 3px 14px #0000000c;
  color-scheme: dark;
}
* { box-sizing: border-box; }
html, body { margin: 0; min-height: 100%; }
body { --font-body: var(--font-inter), Arial, sans-serif; background: var(--background); color: var(--ink); font: 13px/1.5 var(--font-body); -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
::selection { background: #9be5f17a; }
button, input, select, textarea { font: inherit; }
button, a, input, select, textarea { -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
button { cursor: pointer; color: inherit; border: 0; }
button, a { touch-action: manipulation; }
button:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .5; }
a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
button, a, input, textarea, select { outline-offset: 4px; }
:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--teal); }
h1, h2, h3, h4, p { margin: 0; }
h1, h2, h3 { font-weight: 600; }
h1 { font-size: 29px; line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: -1.05px; }
h2 { font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.4; letter-spacing: -.3px; }
h3 { font-size: 14px; }
svg { flex-shrink: 0; }
input, textarea, select { background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 7px; padding: 10px 12px; width: 100%; min-width: 0; transition: border-color .15s; }
input::placeholder, textarea::placeholder { color: var(--muted); }
input:focus, textarea:focus, select:focus { border-color: var(--teal); outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 30%, transparent); outline-offset: 0; }
textarea { resize: vertical; line-height: 1.65; }
input[type="checkbox"] { width: 16px; height: 16px; accent-color: var(--teal); }
input[readonly] { color: var(--muted); background: var(--background); }
.button { min-height: 39px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 7px; padding: 9px 15px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.4; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; transition: background .15s, box-shadow .15s, transform .15s; }
.button:hover:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 3px 8px #1d293911; }
.button-primary { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); border-color: #84d5e21a; }
.button-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #89dce9; }
.button-secondary { background: var(--surface); color: var(--secondary); border-color: var(--border); }
.button-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--surface-hover); }
.button-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--secondary); }
.button-danger { background: #c95660; color: #fff; }
.button-record-stop { background: #f5dfe2; color: #a6444c; }
.icon-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); flex-shrink: 0; }
.icon-button:hover { background: var(--surface-hover); color: var(--ink); }
.danger { color: var(--danger); }
.card, .detail-card { border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface); box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
.detail-card { padding: 24px; }
.detail-card > h2 { display: flex; gap: 9px; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 21px; }
.muted { color: var(--muted); }
.teal-text { color: var(--teal); }
.cyan-text { color: var(--accent); }
.small-text { font-size: 11px; }
.eyebrow { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 1.1px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; }
.text-link { background: transparent; padding: 0; color: var(--secondary); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; }
.text-link:hover { color: var(--teal); }
.meta-item { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; }
.tiny-dot { display: inline-block; width: 5px; height: 5px; background: #7cb6a5; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; }
.cyan { color: #378e9e; background: #e9f7fa; }
.purple { color: #9b88c8; background: #f1edf9; }
.orange { color: #c99266; background: #fbf1e8; }
.green { color: #69a191; background: #eaf5ef; }
[data-theme="dark"] .cyan { background: #203e49; color: #93d4df; }
[data-theme="dark"] .purple { background: #38304d; color: #b9a0e9; }
[data-theme="dark"] .orange { background: #403429; color: #e1b288; }
[data-theme="dark"] .green { background: #253f36; color: #92c4ad; }
.spin { animation: spin 1s linear infinite; }
@keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
@keyframes fade-up { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(5px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }
.badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--teal); border-radius: 5px; padding: 3px 7px; font-size: 10px; }
.badge-neutral { background: var(--background); color: var(--secondary); }
.badge-green { background: #eaf5ef; color: #63967f; }
.app-loading { min-height: 100vh; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 15px; background: #1b2130; color: white; font: 600 40px var(--font-outfit), sans-serif; }
.skip-link { position: fixed; top: -80px; left: 20px; z-index: 100; padding: 10px 18px; background: var(--accent); border-radius: 8px; color: #174454; }
.skip-link:focus { top: 12px; }
.welcome-banner { min-height: 211px; position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; background: linear-gradient(108deg, #edf7f7 0%, #e7f5f5 45%, #e2f1f1 100%); border: 1px solid #dcecec; border-radius: 11px; padding: 25px 30px; overflow: hidden; }
.welcome-content { z-index: 2; position: relative; }
.banner-eyebrow { font-size: 8px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 1.1px; color: #668d90; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.banner-eyebrow > span { width: 4px; height: 4px; background: #6e9c9f; border-radius: 50%; }
.welcome-content h2 { font-size: 28px; line-height: 1.17; letter-spacing: -.9px; color: #29484d; font-weight: 600; margin-top: 11px; }
.welcome-content p { color: #739096; font-size: 10px; margin-top: 12px; }
.banner-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 19px; margin-top: 21px; }
.banner-actions .button { min-height: 33px; font-size: 10px; padding: 7px 12px; background: #29535b; color: #f1ffff; }
.banner-actions .button:hover { background: #386a74; }
.upload-action { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: #587a81; background: transparent; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; }
.conversation-art { position: absolute; width: 380px; height: 250px; right: 5%; top: 4px; }
.art-orbit { position: absolute; border: 1px solid #badad952; border-radius: 50%; left: 50%; top: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); }
.orbit-one { width: 204px; height: 204px; background: #cde9e629; }
.orbit-two { width: 297px; height: 297px; }
.orbit-three { width: 389px; height: 389px; }
.wave-card { height: 100px; width: 278px; position: absolute; top: 73px; left: 48px; border: 1px solid #ffffffd9; border-radius: 13px; background: #ffffffb5; backdrop-filter: blur(3px); box-shadow: 0 15px 30px #4c8b8b12; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; transform: rotate(-7deg); padding: 17px 18px; }
.hero-wave { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px; height: 67px; flex: 1; }
.hero-wave i { width: 3px; border-radius: 3px; background: #69aeb8; opacity: .75; }
.hero-wave i:nth-child(3n) { background: #91c6c6; }
.wave-timestamp { position: absolute; font-size: 8px; color: #809d9e; left: 16px; bottom: 7px; letter-spacing: .5px; }
.wave-play { background: #d2eff0; color: #61999e; width: 33px; height: 33px; border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
.art-tag { position: absolute; z-index: 2; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; border: 1px solid #ffffffcc; border-radius: 7px; padding: 9px 11px; color: #547477; background: #ffffffde; box-shadow: 0 7px 15px #497b7b0b; font-size: 9px; }
.tag-top { top: 36px; left: 64px; transform: rotate(-7deg); }
.tag-bottom { bottom: 28px; right: 37px; transform: rotate(5deg); }
.recording-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; background: #d58b7e; display: inline-block; border-radius: 50%; }
.art-check { width: 19px; height: 19px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #e5f3ea; color: #79a08b; border-radius: 50%; }
.art-star { position: absolute; color: #81b2b4; font-size: 25px; }
.star-one { top: 34px; right: 36px; }
.star-two { bottom: 25px; left: 27px; font-size: 19px; }
.stats-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 17px; margin: 22px 0 26px; }
.stat-card { display: grid; align-items: center; grid-template-columns: 36px 1fr; grid-template-rows: auto auto; column-gap: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--surface); padding: 16px 18px 13px; border-radius: 9px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
.stat-icon { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 9px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; grid-row: span 2; align-self: start; margin-top: 3px; }
.stat-info { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; }
.stat-info > span { color: var(--secondary); font-size: 10px; }
.stat-info > strong { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -.7px; line-height: 1.4; }
.stat-note { font-size: 9px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 4px; }
.section-heading { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 15px; }
.section-heading h2 { display: flex; gap: 9px; align-items: center; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; }
.count-badge { font-size: 9px; padding: 1px 6px; min-width: 18px; background: #eef1f4; border: 1px solid var(--border); color: #8791a0; border-radius: 5px; font-weight: 500; }
.meeting-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 17px; }
.meeting-card { padding: 18px 18px 14px; transition: box-shadow .2s, border-color .2s, transform .2s; }
.meeting-card:hover { border-color: #b9dce0; box-shadow: 0 5px 20px #2b6a760b; transform: translateY(-2px); }
.meeting-card-top { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; margin-bottom: 18px; }
.meeting-symbol { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 9px; flex-shrink: 0; }
.meeting-card-top .status-badge { margin-left: auto; }
.meeting-open { color: var(--muted); opacity: .75; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 3px; }
.meeting-title { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink); display: block; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; overflow: hidden; }
.meeting-title:hover { color: var(--teal); }
.meeting-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; margin-top: 9px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 9px; }
.meeting-card-footer { margin-top: 17px; padding-top: 13px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; }
.card-todo-count { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 9px; }
.dashboard-bottom { margin-top: 27px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.63fr 1fr; gap: 23px; }
.todo-panel { border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 9px; background: var(--surface); overflow: hidden; box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
.todo-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); padding: 17px 20px 17px 22px; }
.todo-row:hover { background: var(--surface-hover); }
.todo-compact { padding-top: 13px; padding-bottom: 13px; gap: 11px; }
.todo-checkbox { width: 16px; height: 16px; border: 1.5px solid #d7dde4; border-radius: 5px; background: var(--surface); padding: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; }
.todo-checkbox:hover { border-color: var(--teal); }
.todo-main { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.todo-title { display: block; width: fit-content; max-width: 100%; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.todo-compact .todo-title { font-size: 11px; }
.todo-title:hover { color: var(--teal); }
.todo-context { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-top: 4px; font-size: 9px; color: var(--muted); }
.todo-context .chip-compact { font-size: 8px; }
.todo-context .chip-compact svg { width: 10px; height: 10px; }
.subtodo-count, .manual-todo { font-size: 9px; }
.is-complete .todo-checkbox { color: white; background: #83b3a0; border-color: #83b3a0; }
.is-complete .todo-title { color: var(--muted); text-decoration: line-through; }
.due-label { font-size: 9px; color: var(--muted); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; white-space: nowrap; }
.due-today { color: #b48b57; }
.overdue { color: var(--danger); }
.priority-indicator { opacity: .7; display: flex; align-items: center; }
.priority-high { color: #c98575; }
.priority-medium { color: #c2a261; }
.priority-low { color: #94a3b5; }
.todo-open { color: var(--muted); display: flex; }
.add-todo-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; width: 100%; padding: 13px 22px; font-size: 10px; color: var(--muted); background: transparent; text-align: left; }
.add-todo-row:hover { color: var(--teal); background: var(--surface-hover); }
.upcoming-panel { border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--surface); border-radius: 9px; overflow: hidden; }
.upcoming-meeting { padding: 16px 19px; }
.upcoming-meeting + .upcoming-meeting { border-top: 1px solid var(--border); }
.upcoming-date { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; font-size: 9px; color: var(--muted); }
.date-pill { color: #689590; font-size: 9px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; }
.upcoming-title { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; margin: 10px 0 12px; }
.upcoming-title svg { color: var(--muted); }
.upcoming-footer { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; color: var(--muted); font-size: 9px; }
.studio-link { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; color: #648c94; border: 1px solid #deebee; background: #f5fafb; padding: 7px; border-radius: 5px; font-size: 9px; margin-top: 14px; }
.studio-link > svg:last-child { margin-left: auto; }
.studio-link > svg:first-child { margin-right: auto; }
.onboarding-bar { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 9px; padding: 16px 19px; margin-top: 25px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; }
.onboarding-icon { width: 35px; height: 35px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 9px; background: #f3f0fb; color: #a091c2; }
.onboarding-bar > div:nth-child(2) { flex: 1; }
.onboarding-bar strong { display: block; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; }
.onboarding-bar > div:nth-child(2) > span { color: var(--muted); font-size: 9px; display: block; margin-top: 3px; }
.onboarding-progress { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; margin-right: 22px; font-size: 9px; color: var(--muted); }
.onboarding-progress > div { width: 72px; height: 4px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--border); overflow: hidden; }
.onboarding-progress i { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--accent); }
.compact-empty { padding: 32px 20px; text-align: center; color: var(--muted); }
.compact-empty > svg { color: var(--teal); }
.compact-empty p { margin: 15px 0; font-size: 12px; }
.all-done { padding: 50px 20px; text-align: center; color: var(--teal); }
.all-done p { margin-top: 10px; }
[data-theme="dark"] .welcome-banner { background: linear-gradient(110deg, #21393e, #1d3038); border-color: #2c494f; }
[data-theme="dark"] .welcome-content h2 { color: #d6eeed; }
[data-theme="dark"] .welcome-content p, [data-theme="dark"] .banner-eyebrow { color: #87aaad; }
[data-theme="dark"] .upload-action { color: #a8cbd0; }
[data-theme="dark"] .conversation-art { opacity: .8; }
[data-theme="dark"] .count-badge { background: #273345; }
[data-theme="dark"] .studio-link { background: #253d46; border-color: #31505a; color: #b0dfe5; }
[data-theme="dark"] .onboarding-icon { background: #332e48; }
@media (min-width: 1600px) {
  .page-content { padding-top: 38px; }
  .welcome-banner { min-height: 235px; }
  .conversation-art { right: 8%; }
  .meeting-card { padding: 23px; }
  .meeting-title { font-size: 15px; }
  .todo-compact { padding-top: 17px; padding-bottom: 17px; }
  .todo-compact .todo-title { font-size: 12px; }
}
@media (max-width: 1180px) {
  .sidebar { width: 222px; padding-left: 14px; padding-right: 14px; }
  .main-shell { margin-left: 222px; }
  .topbar { padding: 0 26px; }
  .page-content { padding: 28px 26px 20px; }
  .conversation-art { right: -35px; opacity: .8; transform: scale(.85); }
  .welcome-content { max-width: 64%; }
  .welcome-content p { max-width: 290px; }
  .meeting-grid, .stats-grid { gap: 12px; }
  .meeting-card { padding: 16px 13px 12px; }
  .meeting-card-top { gap: 5px; }
  .meeting-card-top .meeting-open { display: none; }
  .meeting-title { font-size: 11px; }
  .stat-card { padding: 13px; column-gap: 10px; }
  .stat-info { flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0; }
  .stat-info > span { flex-basis: 100%; }
  .stat-info > strong { font-size: 20px; }
  .stat-note { font-size: 8px; }
  .dashboard-bottom { gap: 17px; grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 1fr; }
  .todo-compact { padding-right: 14px; }
  .todo-compact .priority-indicator { display: none; }
  .topbar-actions { gap: 9px; }
  .global-search kbd { margin-left: 4px; }
  .global-search > span { display: none; }
  .detail-grid, .studio-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 230px; gap: 18px; }
  .detail-card { padding: 20px; }
  .detail-tabs { gap: 12px; }
  .detail-tabs button { font-size: 10px; }
  .detail-tabs button svg { width: 14px; }
}
@media (max-width: 960px) {
  .sidebar { width: 206px; }
  .main-shell { margin-left: 206px; }
  .minute-brand { margin-left: 7px; gap: 10px; }
  .minute-brand > span { font-size: 32px; }
  .workspace-switch { padding: 10px 8px; }
  .workspace-switch strong { font-size: 10px; }
  .topbar { padding: 0 23px; }
  .page-content { padding: 25px 23px 20px; }
  .page-heading h1 { font-size: 24px; }
  .page-heading p { max-width: 330px; font-size: 10px; }
  .heading-actions { flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: flex-end; }
  .heading-actions .button { font-size: 10px; }
  .conversation-art { right: -93px; transform: scale(.65); }
  .welcome-content { max-width: 76%; }
  .welcome-content h2 { font-size: 26px; }
  .welcome-banner { padding-left: 24px; }
  .banner-actions { gap: 12px; }
  .upload-action { font-size: 9px; }
  .meeting-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
  .recent-section .meeting-grid > :last-child:nth-child(3) { display: none; }
  .dashboard-bottom { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .upcoming-panel { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
  .upcoming-meeting + .upcoming-meeting { border-top: 0; border-left: 1px solid var(--border); }
  .onboarding-progress { display: none; }
  .page-footer > span:last-child { display: none; }
  .detail-grid, .studio-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .studio-grid > aside { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; }
  .live-transcript { margin-top: 0; }
  .properties-card { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 15px; }
  .properties-card h2 { grid-column: 1 / -1; margin-bottom: 0; }
  .properties-card .property-block, .properties-card .property { margin-top: 0; }
  .properties-card .privacy-note { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
  .settings-row { flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .toast { left: calc(50% + 103px); }
}
@media (max-width: 740px) {
  .sidebar { width: 250px; visibility: hidden; transform: translateX(-100%); transition: transform .2s; padding-top: 26px; }
  .sidebar.sidebar-open { visibility: visible; transform: translateX(0); }
  .sidebar-backdrop { display: block; position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 30; background: #10172570; backdrop-filter: blur(2px); }
  .mobile-close { display: inline-flex; position: absolute; right: 12px; top: 31px; color: #b2bece; }
  .mobile-close:hover { background: #ffffff0c; color: white; }
  .main-shell { margin-left: 0; }
  .mobile-menu { display: inline-flex; margin-left: -5px; }
  .topbar { height: 62px; padding: 0 19px; gap: 8px; }
  .breadcrumb { gap: 8px; font-size: 10px; }
  .breadcrumb-home { display: none; }
  .breadcrumb-workspace { max-width: 130px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
  .breadcrumb-detail, .breadcrumb > svg:last-of-type:not(:first-of-type) { display: none; }
  .topbar-actions { gap: 5px; }
  .global-search kbd, .topbar-divider, .topbar-actions > a { display: none; }
  .global-search { padding: 8px; }
  .topbar-language { font-size: 10px; }

import type { Language } from "./types";

export const uid = () => crypto.randomUUID();
export const locale = (language: Language) => (language === "cs" ? "cs-CZ" : "en-US");
export const initials = (name: string) =>
  name
    .split(" ")
    .map((part) => part[0])
    .slice(0, 2)
    .join("")
    .toUpperCase();

export function dayKey(value: Date | string = new Date()) {
  const date = new Date(value);
  return `${date.getFullYear()}-${String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")}`;
}

export function dateLabel(value: string, language: Language, relative = true) {
  const date = new Date(value.length === 10 ? `${value}T12:00:00` : value);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return "—";
  if (relative && dayKey(date) === dayKey()) return language === "cs" ? "Dnes" : "Today";
  const tomorrow = new Date();
  tomorrow.setDate(tomorrow.getDate() + 1);
  if (relative && dayKey(date) === dayKey(tomorrow)) return language === "cs" ? "Zítra" : "Tomorrow";
  return date.toLocaleDateString(locale(language), { month: "short", day: "numeric" });
}

export const timeLabel = (value: string, language: Language) =>
  new Date(value).toLocaleTimeString(locale(language), { hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit" });
export const clockLabel = (seconds: number) =>
  `${Math.floor(seconds / 60)
    .toString()
    .padStart(2, "0")}:${Math.floor(seconds % 60)
    .toString()
    .padStart(2, "0")}`;

export function localDateTime(value = new Date().toISOString()) {
  const date = new Date(value);
  return `${dayKey(date)}T${String(date.getHours()).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(date.getMinutes()).padStart(2, "0")}`;
}

export function downloadText(name: string, content: string, type = "text/markdown") {
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([content], { type }));
  const link = document.createElement("a");
  link.href = url;
  link.download = name;
  link.click();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
}

    recordings: [],

+# Changelog
+
+## 2026-09-28
+
+- Added a red one-click recording action on the dashboard. It creates a meeting in the current workspace, opens the studio, and starts microphone recording automatically.
+- Reused meeting defaults for both instant and form-created meetings.

+- Scheduled and ad hoc meetings with their own URLs. The red **Start recording** button on the dashboard creates a meeting and opens the studio with recording already starting.
 - Microphone recording, pause/resume, multiple takes, audio uploads, playback, and downloads.
 - Automatic transcription, Markdown summaries, and linked action items.
 - Editable transcripts and Markdown descriptions with internal entity chips.

diff --git a/lib/meeting.ts b/lib/meeting.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..2abd949a7ca0f3a239955bcdd3ee0f0aa2277471
--- /dev/null
+++ b/lib/meeting.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+import type { Meeting, Workspace } from "./types";
+import { uid } from "./utils";
+
+export function createMeeting(workspace: Workspace, participantName: string, date = new Date()): Meeting {
+  return {
+    id: uid(),
+    workspaceId: workspace.id,
+    title: "",
+    description: "",
+    date: date.toISOString(),
+    duration: 30,
+    participants: [participantName],
+    languages: workspace.languages,
+    status: "scheduled",
+    color: "cyan",
+    recordings: [],
+  };
+}

new file mode 100644

+++ b/CHANGELOG.md
@@ -0,0 +1,6 @@
+# Changelog
+
+## 2026-09-28
+
+- Added a red one-click recording action on the dashboard. It creates a meeting in the current workspace, opens the studio, and starts microphone recording automatically.
+- Reused meeting defaults for both instant and form-created meetings.

 ## Features
 
 - Multiple workspaces with inherited English/Czech meeting languages.
-- Scheduled and ad hoc meetings with their own URLs.
+- Scheduled and ad hoc meetings with their own URLs. The red **Start recording** button on the dashboard creates a meeting and opens the studio with recording already starting.
 - Microphone recording, pause/resume, multiple takes, audio uploads, playback, and downloads.
 - Automatic transcription, Markdown summaries, and linked action items.
 - Editable transcripts and Markdown descriptions with internal entity chips.

+Use HTTPS outside localhost for microphone access and PWA installation. On the first one-click recording, allow the browser's microphone permission request. new file mode 100644

--- /dev/null

@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+import type { Meeting, Workspace } from "./types";
+import { uid } from "./utils";
+
+export function createMeeting(workspace: Workspace, participantName: string, date = new Date()): Meeting {
+  return {
+    id: uid(),

The one-click flow is in place. It uses the same meeting defaults as the form, and its auto-start request is held in app state so opening a studio URL later won’t request the microphone. I’ve added the changelog and README notes; I’m moving on to validation.

@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+import type { Meeting, Workspace } from "./types";
+import { uid } from "./utils";
+
+export function createMeeting(workspace: Workspace, participantName: string, date = new Date()): Meeting {
+  return {
+    id: uid(),
+    workspaceId: workspace.id,
+    title: "",
+    description: "",
+    date: date.toISOString(),
+    duration: 30,
+    participants: [participantName],
+    languages: workspace.languages,
+    status: "scheduled",
+    color: "cyan",
+    recordings: [],
+  };
+}

+# Changelog
+
+## 2026-09-28
+
+- Added a red one-click recording action on the dashboard. It creates a meeting in the current workspace, opens the studio, and starts microphone recording automatically.
+- Reused meeting defaults for both instant and form-created meetings.

+- Scheduled and ad hoc meetings with their own URLs. The red **Start recording** button on the dashboard creates a meeting and opens the studio with recording already starting.
 - Microphone recording, pause/resume, multiple takes, audio uploads, playback, and downloads.
 - Automatic transcription, Markdown summaries, and linked action items.
 - Editable transcripts and Markdown descriptions with internal entity chips.

+import type { Meeting, Workspace } from "./types";
+import { uid } from "./utils";
+
+export function createMeeting(workspace: Workspace, participantName: string, date = new Date()): Meeting {

+    title: "",
+    description: "",
+    date: date.toISOString(),

+    participants: [participantName],

+    status: "scheduled",
+    color: "cyan",
+    recordings: [],
+  };
+}

+# Changelog
+
+## 2026-09-28
+
+- Added a red one-click recording action on the dashboard. It creates a meeting in the current workspace, opens the studio, and starts microphone recording automatically.
+- Reused meeting defaults for both instant and form-created meetings.

 - Automatic transcription, Markdown summaries, and linked action items.
 - Editable transcripts and Markdown descriptions with internal entity chips.

new file mode 100644

--- /dev/null

@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+import type { Meeting, Workspace } from "./types";
+import { uid } from "./utils";
+
+export function createMeeting(workspace: Workspace, participantName: string, date = new Date()): Meeting {
+  return {
+    id: uid(),
+    workspaceId: workspace.id,
+    title: "",
+    description: "",
+    date: date.toISOString(),
+    duration: 30,
+    participants: [participantName],
+    languages: workspace.languages,
+    status: "scheduled",
+    color: "cyan",
+    recordings: [],
+  };
+}

new file mode 100644

@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+import type { Meeting, Workspace } from "./types";
+import { uid } from "./utils";
+
+export function createMeeting(workspace: Workspace, participantName: string, date = new Date()): Meeting {
+  return {
+    id: uid(),
+    workspaceId: workspace.id,
+    title: "",
+    description: "",
+    date: date.toISOString(),
+    duration: 30,
+    participants: [participantName],
+    languages: workspace.languages,
+    status: "scheduled",
+    color: "cyan",
+    recordings: [],
+  };
+}

+# Changelog
+
+## 2026-09-28
+
+- Added a red one-click recording action on the dashboard. It creates a meeting in the current workspace, opens the studio, and starts microphone recording automatically.
+- Reused meeting defaults for both instant and form-created meetings.

+- Scheduled and ad hoc meetings with their own URLs. The red **Start recording** button on the dashboard creates a meeting and opens the studio with recording already starting.
 - Microphone recording, pause/resume, multiple takes, audio uploads, playback, and downloads.
 - Automatic transcription, Markdown summaries, and linked action items.
 - Editable transcripts and Markdown descriptions with internal entity chips.

new file mode 100644

@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+import type { Meeting, Workspace } from "./types";
+import { uid } from "./utils";
+
+export function createMeeting(workspace: Workspace, participantName: string, date = new Date()): Meeting {
+  return {
+    id: uid(),
+    workspaceId: workspace.id,
+    title: "",
+    description: "",
+    date: date.toISOString(),
+    duration: 30,
+    participants: [participantName],
+    languages: workspace.languages,
+    status: "scheduled",
+    color: "cyan",
+    recordings: [],
+  };
+}

+# Changelog
+
+## 2026-09-28
+
+- Added a red one-click recording action on the dashboard. It creates a meeting in the current workspace, opens the studio, and starts microphone recording automatically.
+- Reused meeting defaults for both instant and form-created meetings.

 ## Features
 
 - Multiple workspaces with inherited English/Czech meeting languages.
-- Scheduled and ad hoc meetings with their own URLs.
+- Scheduled and ad hoc meetings with their own URLs. The red **Start recording** button on the dashboard creates a meeting and opens the studio with recording already starting.
 - Microphone recording, pause/resume, multiple takes, audio uploads, playback, and downloads.
 - Automatic transcription, Markdown summaries, and linked action items.
 - Editable transcripts and Markdown descriptions with internal entity chips.

-Use HTTPS outside localhost for microphone access and PWA installation. The service worker caches the app shell, visited pages, and static assets; AI processing requires an internet connection. Install through the browser menu (on iOS, Share → Add to Home Screen). The service worker is disabled in development to avoid stale assets.
+Use HTTPS outside localhost for microphone access and PWA installation. On the first one-click recording, allow the browser's microphone permission request. If access is denied, the new meeting remains open in the studio so you can retry. The service worker caches the app shell, visited pages, and static assets; AI processing requires an internet connection. Install through the browser menu (on iOS, Share → Add to Home Screen). The service worker is disabled in development to avoid stale assets.

diff --git a/lib/meeting.ts b/lib/meeting.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..2abd949a7ca0f3a239955bcdd3ee0f0aa2277471
--- /dev/null
+++ b/lib/meeting.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+import type { Meeting, Workspace } from "./types";
+import { uid } from "./utils";
+
+export function createMeeting(workspace: Workspace, participantName: string, date = new Date()): Meeting {
+  return {
+    id: uid(),
+    workspaceId: workspace.id,
+    title: "",
+    description: "",
+    date: date.toISOString(),
+    duration: 30,
+    participants: [participantName],
+    languages: workspace.languages,
+    status: "scheduled",
+    color: "cyan",
+    recordings: [],
+  };
+}

"use client";

import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { CheckCircle2, X } from "lucide-react";
import { initializeStore, takeStorageError, useAppState } from "@/lib/store";
import type { AppState } from "@/lib/types";

interface MinuteContextValue {
  state: AppState;
  t: (english: string, czech: string) => string;
  notify: (message: string) => void;
}

const MinuteContext = createContext<MinuteContextValue | null>(null);

export function MinuteProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const state = useAppState();
  const [toast, setToast] = useState("");
  const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const notify = useCallback((message: string) => {
    setToast(message);
    if (timer.current) clearTimeout(timer.current);
    timer.current = setTimeout(() => setToast(""), 6000);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    initializeStore();
    return () => {
      if (timer.current) clearTimeout(timer.current);
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!state) return;
    const query = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)");
    const apply = () => {
      document.documentElement.dataset.theme = state.user.theme === "system" ? (query.matches ? "dark" : "light") : state.user.theme;
      document.documentElement.lang = state.user.language;
    };
    apply();
    query.addEventListener("change", apply);
    const message = takeStorageError();
    if (message) queueMicrotask(() => notify(message));
    return () => query.removeEventListener("change", apply);
  }, [state, notify]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if ("serviceWorker" in navigator && process.env.NODE_ENV === "production") {
      navigator.serviceWorker.register("/sw.js").catch(() => {
        /* Browser may block service workers. */
      });
    }
  }, []);

  const t = useCallback((english: string, czech: string) => (state?.user.language === "cs" ? czech : english), [state?.user.language]);

  if (!state)
    return (
      <div className="app-loading">
        <div className="brand-symbol">
          <i />
          <i />
          <i />
          <i />
        </div>
        <span>
          minute<span className="cyan-text">.</span>
        </span>
      </div>
    );

  return (
    <MinuteContext.Provider value={{ state, t, notify }}>
      {children}
      {toast && (
        <div className="toast" role="status">
          <CheckCircle2 size={19} />
          <span>{toast}</span>
          <button className="icon-button" aria-label={t("Dismiss", "Zavřít")} onClick={() => setToast("")}>
            <X size={16} />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </MinuteContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useMinute() {
  const context = useContext(MinuteContext);
  if (!context) throw new Error("useMinute must be used within MinuteProvider");
  return context;
}

new file mode 100644

--- /dev/null

@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+import type { Meeting, Workspace } from "./types";
+import { uid } from "./utils";
+
+export function createMeeting(workspace: Workspace, participantName: string, date = new Date()): Meeting {
+  return {
+    id: uid(),
+    workspaceId: workspace.id,
+    title: "",
+    description: "",
+    date: date.toISOString(),
+    duration: 30,
+    participants: [participantName],
+    languages: workspace.languages,
+    status: "scheduled",
+    color: "cyan",
+    recordings: [],
+  };
+}

+# Changelog
+
+## 2026-09-28
+
+- Added a red one-click recording action on the dashboard. It creates a meeting in the current workspace, opens the studio, and starts microphone recording automatically.
+- Reused meeting defaults for both instant and form-created meetings.

 - Editable transcripts and Markdown descriptions with internal entity chips.

diff --git a/lib/meeting.ts b/lib/meeting.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..2abd949a7ca0f3a239955bcdd3ee0f0aa2277471
--- /dev/null
+++ b/lib/meeting.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+import type { Meeting, Workspace } from "./types";
+import { uid } from "./utils";
+
+export function createMeeting(workspace: Workspace, participantName: string, date = new Date()): Meeting {
+  return {
+    id: uid(),
+    workspaceId: workspace.id,
+    title: "",
+    description: "",
+    date: date.toISOString(),
+    duration: 30,
+    participants: [participantName],
+    languages: workspace.languages,
+    status: "scheduled",
+    color: "cyan",
+    recordings: [],

+import type { Meeting, Workspace } from "./types";
+import { uid } from "./utils";
+
+export function createMeeting(workspace: Workspace, participantName: string, date = new Date()): Meeting {
+  return {
+    id: uid(),
+    workspaceId: workspace.id,
+    title: "",
+    description: "",
+    date: date.toISOString(),
+    duration: 30,
+    participants: [participantName],
+    languages: workspace.languages,
+    status: "scheduled",
+    color: "cyan",
+    recordings: [],
+  };
+}

+
+## 2026-09-28

+- Reused meeting defaults for both instant and form-created meetings.

+import type { Meeting, Workspace } from "./types";
+import { uid } from "./utils";
+
+export function createMeeting(workspace: Workspace, participantName: string, date = new Date()): Meeting {
+  return {
+    id: uid(),
+    workspaceId: workspace.id,
+    title: "",
+    description: "",
+    date: date.toISOString(),
+    duration: 30,
+    participants: [participantName],
+    languages: workspace.languages,
+    status: "scheduled",
+    color: "cyan",
+    recordings: [],
+  };
+}

+# Changelog
+
+## 2026-09-28
+
+- Added a red one-click recording action on the dashboard. It creates a meeting in the current workspace, opens the studio, and starts microphone recording automatically.
+- Reused meeting defaults for both instant and form-created meetings.

+- Scheduled and ad hoc meetings with their own URLs. The red **Start recording** button on the dashboard creates a meeting and opens the studio with recording already starting.
 - Microphone recording, pause/resume, multiple takes, audio uploads, playback, and downloads.
 - Automatic transcription, Markdown summaries, and linked action items.
 - Editable transcripts and Markdown descriptions with internal entity chips.

+import type { Meeting, Workspace } from "./types";
+import { uid } from "./utils";
+
+export function createMeeting(workspace: Workspace, participantName: string, date = new Date()): Meeting {
+  return {
+    id: uid(),
+    workspaceId: workspace.id,
+    title: "",
+    description: "",
+    date: date.toISOString(),

+    status: "scheduled",
+    color: "cyan",
+    recordings: [],
+  };
+}

codex
The browser check caught a routing issue: the meeting was created and the studio opened, but the recording request was lost because navigation remounts the app shell. I’ll keep that one-time request in a small client module so the studio can consume it after navigation.

+# Changelog
+
+## 2026-09-28
+
+- Added a red one-click recording action on the dashboard. It creates a meeting in the current workspace, opens the studio, and starts microphone recording automatically.
+- Reused meeting defaults for both instant and form-created meetings.

 - Editable transcripts and Markdown descriptions with internal entity chips.

+import type { Meeting, Workspace } from "./types";
+import { uid } from "./utils";
+
+export function createMeeting(workspace: Workspace, participantName: string, date = new Date()): Meeting {
+  return {
+    id: uid(),
+    workspaceId: workspace.id,
+    title: "",
+    description: "",
+    date: date.toISOString(),
+    duration: 30,

+    status: "scheduled",
+    color: "cyan",
+    recordings: [],
+  };
+}
diff --git a/lib/recording-intent.ts b/lib/recording-intent.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..8908701b6c0b5cade37222749250032a0d128903
--- /dev/null
+++ b/lib/recording-intent.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+let pendingMeetingId: string | null = null;
+
+export function requestRecordingStart(meetingId: string) {
+  pendingMeetingId = meetingId;
+}
+
+export function consumeRecordingStart(meetingId: string) {
+  if (pendingMeetingId !== meetingId) return false;
+  pendingMeetingId = null;
+  return true;
+}

+# Changelog
+
+## 2026-09-28
+
+- Added a red one-click recording action on the dashboard. It creates a meeting in the current workspace, opens the studio, and starts microphone recording automatically.
+- Reused meeting defaults for both instant and form-created meetings.

@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+import type { Meeting, Workspace } from "./types";
+import { uid } from "./utils";
+
+export function createMeeting(workspace: Workspace, participantName: string, date = new Date()): Meeting {
+  return {
+    id: uid(),
+    workspaceId: workspace.id,
+    title: "",
+    description: "",
+    date: date.toISOString(),
+    duration: 30,
+    participants: [participantName],
+    languages: workspace.languages,
+    status: "scheduled",
+    color: "cyan",
+    recordings: [],
+  };
+}
diff --git a/lib/recording-intent.ts b/lib/recording-intent.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..8908701b6c0b5cade37222749250032a0d128903
--- /dev/null
+++ b/lib/recording-intent.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+let pendingMeetingId: string | null = null;
+
+export function requestRecordingStart(meetingId: string) {
+  pendingMeetingId = meetingId;
+}
+
+export function consumeRecordingStart(meetingId: string) {
+  if (pendingMeetingId !== meetingId) return false;
+  pendingMeetingId = null;
+  return true;
+}

+import type { Meeting, Workspace } from "./types";
+import { uid } from "./utils";
+
+export function createMeeting(workspace: Workspace, participantName: string, date = new Date()): Meeting {
+  return {
+    id: uid(),
+    workspaceId: workspace.id,
+    title: "",
+    description: "",
+    date: date.toISOString(),
+    duration: 30,
+    participants: [participantName],
+    languages: workspace.languages,
+    status: "scheduled",
+    color: "cyan",
+    recordings: [],
+  };
+}

new file mode 100644

@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+let pendingMeetingId: string | null = null;
+
+export function requestRecordingStart(meetingId: string) {
+  pendingMeetingId = meetingId;
+}
+
+export function consumeRecordingStart(meetingId: string) {
+  if (pendingMeetingId !== meetingId) return false;
+  pendingMeetingId = null;
+  return true;
+}

+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import test from "node:test";
+import { consumeRecordingStart, requestRecordingStart } from "../lib/recording-intent";
+
+test("an instant recording request is consumed once by its meeting studio", () => {
+  requestRecordingStart("new-meeting");
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("another-meeting"), false);
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("new-meeting"), true);
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("new-meeting"), false);
+});

new file mode 100644

--- /dev/null

@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+import type { Meeting, Workspace } from "./types";
+import { uid } from "./utils";
+
+export function createMeeting(workspace: Workspace, participantName: string, date = new Date()): Meeting {
+  return {
+    id: uid(),
+    workspaceId: workspace.id,
+    title: "",
+    description: "",
+    date: date.toISOString(),
+    duration: 30,
+    participants: [participantName],
+    languages: workspace.languages,
+    status: "scheduled",
+    color: "cyan",
+    recordings: [],
+  };
+}
diff --git a/lib/recording-intent.ts b/lib/recording-intent.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..8908701b6c0b5cade37222749250032a0d128903
--- /dev/null
+++ b/lib/recording-intent.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+let pendingMeetingId: string | null = null;
+
+export function requestRecordingStart(meetingId: string) {
+  pendingMeetingId = meetingId;
+}
+
+export function consumeRecordingStart(meetingId: string) {
+  if (pendingMeetingId !== meetingId) return false;
+  pendingMeetingId = null;
+  return true;
+}

new file mode 100644

--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/recording-intent.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,10 @@
+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import test from "node:test";
+import { consumeRecordingStart, requestRecordingStart } from "../lib/recording-intent";
+
+test("an instant recording request is consumed once by its meeting studio", () => {
+  requestRecordingStart("new-meeting");
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("another-meeting"), false);
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("new-meeting"), true);
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("new-meeting"), false);
+});

+# Changelog
+
+## 2026-09-28
+
+- Added a red one-click recording action on the dashboard. It creates a meeting in the current workspace, opens the studio, and starts microphone recording automatically.
+- Reused meeting defaults for both instant and form-created meetings.

+- Scheduled and ad hoc meetings with their own URLs. The red **Start recording** button on the dashboard creates a meeting and opens the studio with recording already starting.
 - Microphone recording, pause/resume, multiple takes, audio uploads, playback, and downloads.
 - Automatic transcription, Markdown summaries, and linked action items.
 - Editable transcripts and Markdown descriptions with internal entity chips.

+Use HTTPS outside localhost for microphone access and PWA installation. On the first one-click recording, allow the browser's microphone permission request. new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..2abd949a7ca0f3a239955bcdd3ee0f0aa2277471
--- /dev/null

@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+import type { Meeting, Workspace } from "./types";
+import { uid } from "./utils";
+
+export function createMeeting(workspace: Workspace, participantName: string, date = new Date()): Meeting {
+  return {
+    id: uid(),
+    workspaceId: workspace.id,
+    title: "",
+    description: "",
+    date: date.toISOString(),
+    duration: 30,
+    participants: [participantName],
+    languages: workspace.languages,
+    status: "scheduled",
+    color: "cyan",
+    recordings: [],
+  };
+}
diff --git a/lib/recording-intent.ts b/lib/recording-intent.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..8908701b6c0b5cade37222749250032a0d128903
--- /dev/null
+++ b/lib/recording-intent.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+let pendingMeetingId: string | null = null;
+
+export function requestRecordingStart(meetingId: string) {
+  pendingMeetingId = meetingId;
+}
+
+export function consumeRecordingStart(meetingId: string) {
+  if (pendingMeetingId !== meetingId) return false;
+  pendingMeetingId = null;
+  return true;
+}

new file mode 100644

--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/recording-intent.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,10 @@
+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import test from "node:test";
+import { consumeRecordingStart, requestRecordingStart } from "../lib/recording-intent";
+
+test("an instant recording request is consumed once by its meeting studio", () => {
+  requestRecordingStart("new-meeting");
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("another-meeting"), false);
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("new-meeting"), true);
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("new-meeting"), false);
+});

@@ -0,0 +1,6 @@
+# Changelog
+
+## 2026-09-28
+
+- Added a red one-click recording action on the dashboard. It creates a meeting in the current workspace, opens the studio, and starts microphone recording automatically.
+- Reused meeting defaults for both instant and form-created meetings.

 - Microphone recording, pause/resume, multiple takes, audio uploads, playback, and downloads.
 - Automatic transcription, Markdown summaries, and linked action items.
 - Editable transcripts and Markdown descriptions with internal entity chips.

+import type { Meeting, Workspace } from "./types";
+import { uid } from "./utils";
+
+export function createMeeting(workspace: Workspace, participantName: string, date = new Date()): Meeting {
+  return {
+    id: uid(),
+    workspaceId: workspace.id,
+    title: "",
+    description: "",
+    date: date.toISOString(),
+    duration: 30,
+    participants: [participantName],
+    languages: workspace.languages,
+    status: "scheduled",
+    color: "cyan",
+    recordings: [],
+  };
+}

+let pendingMeetingId: string | null = null;
+
+export function requestRecordingStart(meetingId: string) {
+  pendingMeetingId = meetingId;
+}
+
+export function consumeRecordingStart(meetingId: string) {
+  if (pendingMeetingId !== meetingId) return false;
+  pendingMeetingId = null;
+  return true;
+}

+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import test from "node:test";
+import { consumeRecordingStart, requestRecordingStart } from "../lib/recording-intent";
+
+test("an instant recording request is consumed once by its meeting studio", () => {
+  requestRecordingStart("new-meeting");
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("another-meeting"), false);
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("new-meeting"), true);
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("new-meeting"), false);
+});

+import type { Meeting, Workspace } from "./types";
+import { uid } from "./utils";
+
+export function createMeeting(workspace: Workspace, participantName: string, date = new Date()): Meeting {
+  return {
+    id: uid(),
+    workspaceId: workspace.id,
+    title: "",
+    description: "",
+    date: date.toISOString(),
+    duration: 30,
+    participants: [participantName],
+    languages: workspace.languages,
+    status: "scheduled",
+    color: "cyan",
+    recordings: [],
+  };
+}

new file mode 100644

@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+let pendingMeetingId: string | null = null;
+
+export function requestRecordingStart(meetingId: string) {
+  pendingMeetingId = meetingId;
+}
+
+export function consumeRecordingStart(meetingId: string) {
+  if (pendingMeetingId !== meetingId) return false;
+  pendingMeetingId = null;
+  return true;
+}

+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import test from "node:test";
+import { consumeRecordingStart, requestRecordingStart } from "../lib/recording-intent";
+
+test("an instant recording request is consumed once by its meeting studio", () => {
+  requestRecordingStart("new-meeting");
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("another-meeting"), false);
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("new-meeting"), true);
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("new-meeting"), false);
+});

+# Changelog
+
+## 2026-09-28
+
+- Added a red one-click recording action on the dashboard. It creates a meeting in the current workspace, opens the studio, and starts microphone recording automatically.
+- Reused meeting defaults for both instant and form-created meetings.

 - Editable transcripts and Markdown descriptions with internal entity chips.

diff --git a/lib/meeting.ts b/lib/meeting.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..2abd949a7ca0f3a239955bcdd3ee0f0aa2277471
--- /dev/null
+++ b/lib/meeting.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+import type { Meeting, Workspace } from "./types";
+import { uid } from "./utils";
+
+export function createMeeting(workspace: Workspace, participantName: string, date = new Date()): Meeting {
+  return {
+    id: uid(),
+    workspaceId: workspace.id,
+    title: "",
+    description: "",
+    date: date.toISOString(),
+    duration: 30,
+    participants: [participantName],
+    languages: workspace.languages,
+    status: "scheduled",
+    color: "cyan",
+    recordings: [],
+  };
+}
diff --git a/lib/recording-intent.ts b/lib/recording-intent.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..8908701b6c0b5cade37222749250032a0d128903
--- /dev/null
+++ b/lib/recording-intent.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+let pendingMeetingId: string | null = null;
+
+export function requestRecordingStart(meetingId: string) {
+  pendingMeetingId = meetingId;
+}
+
+export function consumeRecordingStart(meetingId: string) {
+  if (pendingMeetingId !== meetingId) return false;
+  pendingMeetingId = null;
+  return true;
+}
diff --git a/tests/recording-intent.test.ts b/tests/recording-intent.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..14cdd15fefdecaf44d8d17bf400d59f794ad1b18
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/recording-intent.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,10 @@
+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import test from "node:test";
+import { consumeRecordingStart, requestRecordingStart } from "../lib/recording-intent";
+
+test("an instant recording request is consumed once by its meeting studio", () => {
+  requestRecordingStart("new-meeting");
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("another-meeting"), false);
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("new-meeting"), true);
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("new-meeting"), false);
+});

+# Changelog
+
+## 2026-09-28
+
+- Added a red one-click recording action on the dashboard. It creates a meeting in the current workspace, opens the studio, and starts microphone recording automatically.
+- Reused meeting defaults for both instant and form-created meetings.

@@ -0,0 +1,10 @@
+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import test from "node:test";
+import { consumeRecordingStart, requestRecordingStart } from "../lib/recording-intent";
+
+test("an instant recording request is consumed once by its meeting studio", () => {

+import type { Meeting, Workspace } from "./types";
+import { uid } from "./utils";
+
+export function createMeeting(workspace: Workspace, participantName: string, date = new Date()): Meeting {
+  return {
+    id: uid(),
+    workspaceId: workspace.id,
+    title: "",
+    description: "",
+    date: date.toISOString(),
+    duration: 30,
+    participants: [participantName],
+    languages: workspace.languages,
+    status: "scheduled",
+    color: "cyan",
+    recordings: [],
+  };
+}
diff --git a/lib/recording-intent.ts b/lib/recording-intent.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..8908701b6c0b5cade37222749250032a0d128903
--- /dev/null
+++ b/lib/recording-intent.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+let pendingMeetingId: string | null = null;
+
+export function requestRecordingStart(meetingId: string) {
+  pendingMeetingId = meetingId;
+}
+
+export function consumeRecordingStart(meetingId: string) {
+  if (pendingMeetingId !== meetingId) return false;
+  pendingMeetingId = null;
+  return true;
+}

+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import test from "node:test";
+import { consumeRecordingStart, requestRecordingStart } from "../lib/recording-intent";
+
+test("an instant recording request is consumed once by its meeting studio", () => {
+  requestRecordingStart("new-meeting");
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("another-meeting"), false);
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("new-meeting"), true);
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("new-meeting"), false);
+});

+import type { Meeting, Workspace } from "./types";
+import { uid } from "./utils";
+
+export function createMeeting(workspace: Workspace, participantName: string, date = new Date()): Meeting {
+  return {
+    id: uid(),
+    workspaceId: workspace.id,
+    title: "",
+    description: "",
+    date: date.toISOString(),
+    duration: 30,
+    participants: [participantName],
+    languages: workspace.languages,
+    status: "scheduled",
+    color: "cyan",
+    recordings: [],
+  };
+}

+let pendingMeetingId: string | null = null;
+
+export function requestRecordingStart(meetingId: string) {
+  pendingMeetingId = meetingId;
+}
+
+export function consumeRecordingStart(meetingId: string) {
+  if (pendingMeetingId !== meetingId) return false;
+  pendingMeetingId = null;
+  return true;
+}

+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import test from "node:test";
+import { consumeRecordingStart, requestRecordingStart } from "../lib/recording-intent";
+
+test("an instant recording request is consumed once by its meeting studio", () => {
+  requestRecordingStart("new-meeting");
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("another-meeting"), false);
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("new-meeting"), true);
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("new-meeting"), false);
+});

new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..2abd949a7ca0f3a239955bcdd3ee0f0aa2277471
--- /dev/null

@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+import type { Meeting, Workspace } from "./types";
+import { uid } from "./utils";
+
+export function createMeeting(workspace: Workspace, participantName: string, date = new Date()): Meeting {
+  return {
+    id: uid(),
+    workspaceId: workspace.id,
+    title: "",
+    description: "",
+    date: date.toISOString(),
+    duration: 30,
+    participants: [participantName],
+    languages: workspace.languages,
+    status: "scheduled",
+    color: "cyan",
+    recordings: [],
+  };
+}
diff --git a/lib/recording-intent.ts b/lib/recording-intent.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..8908701b6c0b5cade37222749250032a0d128903
--- /dev/null
+++ b/lib/recording-intent.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+let pendingMeetingId: string | null = null;
+
+export function requestRecordingStart(meetingId: string) {
+  pendingMeetingId = meetingId;
+}
+
+export function consumeRecordingStart(meetingId: string) {
+  if (pendingMeetingId !== meetingId) return false;
+  pendingMeetingId = null;
+  return true;
+}

new file mode 100644

--- /dev/null

@@ -0,0 +1,10 @@
+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import test from "node:test";
+import { consumeRecordingStart, requestRecordingStart } from "../lib/recording-intent";
+
+test("an instant recording request is consumed once by its meeting studio", () => {
+  requestRecordingStart("new-meeting");
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("another-meeting"), false);
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("new-meeting"), true);
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("new-meeting"), false);
+});

+# Changelog
+
+## 2026-09-28
+
+- Added a red one-click recording action on the dashboard. It creates a meeting in the current workspace, opens the studio, and starts microphone recording automatically.
+- Reused meeting defaults for both instant and form-created meetings.

 - Microphone recording, pause/resume, multiple takes, audio uploads, playback, and downloads.
 - Automatic transcription, Markdown summaries, and linked action items.
 - Editable transcripts and Markdown descriptions with internal entity chips.

+import type { Meeting, Workspace } from "./types";
+import { uid } from "./utils";
+
+export function createMeeting(workspace: Workspace, participantName: string, date = new Date()): Meeting {
+  return {
+    id: uid(),
+    workspaceId: workspace.id,
+    title: "",
+    description: "",
+    date: date.toISOString(),
+    duration: 30,
+    participants: [participantName],
+    languages: workspace.languages,
+    status: "scheduled",
+    color: "cyan",
+    recordings: [],
+  };
+}
diff --git a/lib/recording-intent.ts b/lib/recording-intent.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..8908701b6c0b5cade37222749250032a0d128903
--- /dev/null
+++ b/lib/recording-intent.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+let pendingMeetingId: string | null = null;
+
+export function requestRecordingStart(meetingId: string) {
+  pendingMeetingId = meetingId;
+}
+
+export function consumeRecordingStart(meetingId: string) {
+  if (pendingMeetingId !== meetingId) return false;
+  pendingMeetingId = null;
+  return true;
+}
diff --git a/tests/recording-intent.test.ts b/tests/recording-intent.test.ts
new file mode 100644

--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/recording-intent.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,10 @@
+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import test from "node:test";
+import { consumeRecordingStart, requestRecordingStart } from "../lib/recording-intent";
+
+test("an instant recording request is consumed once by its meeting studio", () => {
+  requestRecordingStart("new-meeting");
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("another-meeting"), false);
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("new-meeting"), true);
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("new-meeting"), false);
+});

+import type { Meeting, Workspace } from "./types";
+import { uid } from "./utils";
+
+export function createMeeting(workspace: Workspace, participantName: string, date = new Date()): Meeting {
+  return {
+    id: uid(),
+    workspaceId: workspace.id,
+    title: "",
+    description: "",
+    date: date.toISOString(),
+    duration: 30,
+    participants: [participantName],
+    languages: workspace.languages,
+    status: "scheduled",
+    color: "cyan",
+    recordings: [],
+  };
+}

new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..8908701b6c0b5cade37222749250032a0d128903
--- /dev/null
+++ b/lib/recording-intent.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+let pendingMeetingId: string | null = null;
+
+export function requestRecordingStart(meetingId: string) {
+  pendingMeetingId = meetingId;
+}
+
+export function consumeRecordingStart(meetingId: string) {
+  if (pendingMeetingId !== meetingId) return false;
+  pendingMeetingId = null;
+  return true;
+}

+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import test from "node:test";
+import { consumeRecordingStart, requestRecordingStart } from "../lib/recording-intent";
+
+test("an instant recording request is consumed once by its meeting studio", () => {
+  requestRecordingStart("new-meeting");
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("another-meeting"), false);
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("new-meeting"), true);
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("new-meeting"), false);
+});

The service worker is disabled in development to avoid stale assets.

+import type { Meeting, Workspace } from "./types";
+import { uid } from "./utils";
+
+export function createMeeting(workspace: Workspace, participantName: string, date = new Date()): Meeting {
+  return {
+    id: uid(),
+    workspaceId: workspace.id,
+    title: "",
+    description: "",
+    date: date.toISOString(),
+    duration: 30,
+    participants: [participantName],
+    languages: workspace.languages,
+    status: "scheduled",
+    color: "cyan",
+    recordings: [],
+  };
+}
diff --git a/lib/recording-intent.ts b/lib/recording-intent.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..8908701b6c0b5cade37222749250032a0d128903
--- /dev/null
+++ b/lib/recording-intent.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+let pendingMeetingId: string | null = null;
+
+export function requestRecordingStart(meetingId: string) {
+  pendingMeetingId = meetingId;
+}
+
+export function consumeRecordingStart(meetingId: string) {
+  if (pendingMeetingId !== meetingId) return false;
+  pendingMeetingId = null;
+  return true;
+}

--- /dev/null

@@ -0,0 +1,10 @@
+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import test from "node:test";
+import { consumeRecordingStart, requestRecordingStart } from "../lib/recording-intent";
+
+test("an instant recording request is consumed once by its meeting studio", () => {
+  requestRecordingStart("new-meeting");
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("another-meeting"), false);
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("new-meeting"), true);
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("new-meeting"), false);
+});

+
+## 2026-09-28
+
+- Added a red one-click recording action on the dashboard. It creates a meeting in the current workspace, opens the studio, and starts microphone recording automatically.
+- Reused meeting defaults for both instant and form-created meetings.

+import type { Meeting, Workspace } from "./types";
+import { uid } from "./utils";
+
+export function createMeeting(workspace: Workspace, participantName: string, date = new Date()): Meeting {
+  return {
+    id: uid(),
+    workspaceId: workspace.id,
+    title: "",
+    description: "",
+    date: date.toISOString(),
+    duration: 30,
+    participants: [participantName],
+    languages: workspace.languages,
+    status: "scheduled",
+    color: "cyan",
+    recordings: [],
+  };
+}
diff --git a/lib/recording-intent.ts b/lib/recording-intent.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..8908701b6c0b5cade37222749250032a0d128903
--- /dev/null
+++ b/lib/recording-intent.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+let pendingMeetingId: string | null = null;
+
+export function requestRecordingStart(meetingId: string) {
+  pendingMeetingId = meetingId;
+}
+
+export function consumeRecordingStart(meetingId: string) {
+  if (pendingMeetingId !== meetingId) return false;
+  pendingMeetingId = null;
+  return true;
+}

+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import test from "node:test";
+import { consumeRecordingStart, requestRecordingStart } from "../lib/recording-intent";
+
+test("an instant recording request is consumed once by its meeting studio", () => {
+  requestRecordingStart("new-meeting");
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("another-meeting"), false);
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("new-meeting"), true);
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("new-meeting"), false);
+});

+import type { Meeting, Workspace } from "./types";
+import { uid } from "./utils";
+
+export function createMeeting(workspace: Workspace, participantName: string, date = new Date()): Meeting {
+  return {
+    id: uid(),
+    workspaceId: workspace.id,
+    title: "",
+    description: "",
+    date: date.toISOString(),
+    duration: 30,

+let pendingMeetingId: string | null = null;
+
+export function requestRecordingStart(meetingId: string) {
+  pendingMeetingId = meetingId;
+}
+
+export function consumeRecordingStart(meetingId: string) {
+  if (pendingMeetingId !== meetingId) return false;
+  pendingMeetingId = null;
+  return true;
+}

+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import test from "node:test";
+import { consumeRecordingStart, requestRecordingStart } from "../lib/recording-intent";
+
+test("an instant recording request is consumed once by its meeting studio", () => {
+  requestRecordingStart("new-meeting");
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("another-meeting"), false);
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("new-meeting"), true);
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("new-meeting"), false);
+});

new file mode 100644

--- /dev/null

@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+import type { Meeting, Workspace } from "./types";
+import { uid } from "./utils";
+
+export function createMeeting(workspace: Workspace, participantName: string, date = new Date()): Meeting {
+  return {
+    id: uid(),
+    workspaceId: workspace.id,
+    title: "",
+    description: "",
+    date: date.toISOString(),
+    duration: 30,
+    participants: [participantName],
+    languages: workspace.languages,
+    status: "scheduled",
+    color: "cyan",
+    recordings: [],
+  };
+}
diff --git a/lib/recording-intent.ts b/lib/recording-intent.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..8908701b6c0b5cade37222749250032a0d128903
--- /dev/null
+++ b/lib/recording-intent.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+let pendingMeetingId: string | null = null;
+
+export function requestRecordingStart(meetingId: string) {
+  pendingMeetingId = meetingId;
+}
+
+export function consumeRecordingStart(meetingId: string) {
+  if (pendingMeetingId !== meetingId) return false;
+  pendingMeetingId = null;
+  return true;
+}
diff --git a/tests/recording-intent.test.ts b/tests/recording-intent.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..14cdd15fefdecaf44d8d17bf400d59f794ad1b18
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/recording-intent.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,10 @@
+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import test from "node:test";
+import { consumeRecordingStart, requestRecordingStart } from "../lib/recording-intent";
+
+test("an instant recording request is consumed once by its meeting studio", () => {
+  requestRecordingStart("new-meeting");
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("another-meeting"), false);
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("new-meeting"), true);
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("new-meeting"), false);
+});

+# Changelog
+
+## 2026-09-28
+
+- Added a red one-click recording action on the dashboard. It creates a meeting in the current workspace, opens the studio, and starts microphone recording automatically.
+- Reused meeting defaults for both instant and form-created meetings.

+# Changelog
+
+## 2026-09-28
+
+- Added a red one-click recording action on the dashboard. It creates a meeting in the current workspace, opens the studio, and starts microphone recording automatically.
+- Reused meeting defaults for both instant and form-created meetings.

 ## Features
 
 - Multiple workspaces with inherited English/Czech meeting languages.
-- Scheduled and ad hoc meetings with their own URLs.
+- Scheduled and ad hoc meetings with their own URLs. The red **Start recording** button on the dashboard creates a meeting and opens the studio with recording already starting.
 - Microphone recording, pause/resume, multiple takes, audio uploads, playback, and downloads.
 - Automatic transcription, Markdown summaries, and linked action items.
 - Editable transcripts and Markdown descriptions with internal entity chips.
@@ -47,7 +47,7 @@
 npm start
 ```

+Use HTTPS outside localhost for microphone access and PWA installation. On the first one-click recording, allow the browser's microphone permission request. diff --git a/lib/meeting.ts b/lib/meeting.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..2abd949a7ca0f3a239955bcdd3ee0f0aa2277471
--- /dev/null
+++ b/lib/meeting.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+import type { Meeting, Workspace } from "./types";
+import { uid } from "./utils";
+
+export function createMeeting(workspace: Workspace, participantName: string, date = new Date()): Meeting {
+  return {
+    id: uid(),
+    workspaceId: workspace.id,
+    title: "",
+    description: "",
+    date: date.toISOString(),
+    duration: 30,
+    participants: [participantName],
+    languages: workspace.languages,
+    status: "scheduled",
+    color: "cyan",
+    recordings: [],
+  };
+}
diff --git a/lib/recording-intent.ts b/lib/recording-intent.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..8908701b6c0b5cade37222749250032a0d128903
--- /dev/null
+++ b/lib/recording-intent.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+let pendingMeetingId: string | null = null;
+
+export function requestRecordingStart(meetingId: string) {
+  pendingMeetingId = meetingId;
+}
+
+export function consumeRecordingStart(meetingId: string) {
+  if (pendingMeetingId !== meetingId) return false;
+  pendingMeetingId = null;
+  return true;
+}
diff --git a/tests/recording-intent.test.ts b/tests/recording-intent.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..14cdd15fefdecaf44d8d17bf400d59f794ad1b18
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/recording-intent.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,10 @@
+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import test from "node:test";
+import { consumeRecordingStart, requestRecordingStart } from "../lib/recording-intent";
+
+test("an instant recording request is consumed once by its meeting studio", () => {
+  requestRecordingStart("new-meeting");
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("another-meeting"), false);
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("new-meeting"), true);
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("new-meeting"), false);
+});

+let pendingMeetingId: string | null = null;
+
+export function requestRecordingStart(meetingId: string) {
+  pendingMeetingId = meetingId;
+}
+
+export function consumeRecordingStart(meetingId: string) {

new file mode 100644

@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+import type { Meeting, Workspace } from "./types";
+import { uid } from "./utils";
+
+export function createMeeting(workspace: Workspace, participantName: string, date = new Date()): Meeting {
+  return {
+    id: uid(),
+    workspaceId: workspace.id,
+    title: "",
+    description: "",
+    date: date.toISOString(),
+    duration: 30,
+    participants: [participantName],
+    languages: workspace.languages,
+    status: "scheduled",
+    color: "cyan",
+    recordings: [],
+  };
+}
diff --git a/lib/recording-intent.ts b/lib/recording-intent.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..8908701b6c0b5cade37222749250032a0d128903
--- /dev/null
+++ b/lib/recording-intent.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+let pendingMeetingId: string | null = null;
+
+export function requestRecordingStart(meetingId: string) {
+  pendingMeetingId = meetingId;
+}
+
+export function consumeRecordingStart(meetingId: string) {
+  if (pendingMeetingId !== meetingId) return false;
+  pendingMeetingId = null;
+  return true;
+}

--- /dev/null

@@ -0,0 +1,10 @@
+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import test from "node:test";
+import { consumeRecordingStart, requestRecordingStart } from "../lib/recording-intent";
+
+test("an instant recording request is consumed once by its meeting studio", () => {
+  requestRecordingStart("new-meeting");
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("another-meeting"), false);
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("new-meeting"), true);
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("new-meeting"), false);
+});

+# Changelog
+
+## 2026-09-28
+
+- Added a red one-click recording action on the dashboard. It creates a meeting in the current workspace, opens the studio, and starts microphone recording automatically.
+- Reused meeting defaults for both instant and form-created meetings.

@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+let pendingMeetingId: string | null = null;
+
+export function requestRecordingStart(meetingId: string) {
+  pendingMeetingId = meetingId;
+}
+
+export function consumeRecordingStart(meetingId: string) {
+  if (pendingMeetingId !== meetingId) return false;
+  pendingMeetingId = null;

+import type { Meeting, Workspace } from "./types";
+import { uid } from "./utils";
+
+export function createMeeting(workspace: Workspace, participantName: string, date = new Date()): Meeting {
+  return {
+    id: uid(),
+    workspaceId: workspace.id,
+    title: "",
+    description: "",
+    date: date.toISOString(),
+    duration: 30,
+    participants: [participantName],
+    languages: workspace.languages,
+    status: "scheduled",
+    color: "cyan",
+    recordings: [],
+  };
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+let pendingMeetingId: string | null = null;
+
+export function requestRecordingStart(meetingId: string) {
+  pendingMeetingId = meetingId;
+}
+
+export function consumeRecordingStart(meetingId: string) {
+  if (pendingMeetingId !== meetingId) return false;
+  pendingMeetingId = null;
+  return true;
+}

+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import test from "node:test";
+import { consumeRecordingStart, requestRecordingStart } from "../lib/recording-intent";
+
+test("an instant recording request is consumed once by its meeting studio", () => {
+  requestRecordingStart("new-meeting");
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("another-meeting"), false);
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("new-meeting"), true);
+  assert.equal(consumeRecordingStart("new-meeting"), false);
+});
````
